comment: LOVE HER! She looks just like Zooey Deschanel and she's smart as hell! Super easy course and you'll learn A TON!

She is AMAZING! Her class is so interesting, you'll learn a lot. Not hard to get a good grade at all. Just go to class, listen and participate. She's a fun professor too, class was always interesting.

Dr. Guillard is one of the best professors I've had at Richmond. She's nice, smart, funny, and always ready to help if you're struggling with something. WGSS200 is a MUST for any Richmond student - you'll learn SO much and have an awesome time with the professor!
